field.label: Domain
field.help: Domain whose queries are forwarded to the resolvers below, subdomains included, e.g. fritz.box also covers printer.fritz.box. Reverse lookups work the same way, e.g. 178.168.192.in-addr.arpa. A name with no dot at all, such as printer on its own, is only matched by an entry of . which acts as the catch-all for unqualified names.

field.label: Resolver
field.help: One or more resolvers for this domain, in the same formats as upstream servers (plain IP, tcp-tls:, https://, quic:, sdns://). Several are raced two at a time, or queried one at a time when the resolver strategy is random; strict order is not applied here, because Blocky always builds a domain override group the parallel way. These groups also start with the blocking startup strategy, whatever the general setting says.
